headline: Russia’s Bonn consulate closes today after Leipzig drone case; Pistorius takes Germany’s first F-35 in Texas; CDU floats 21–25¢/L fuel relief ahead of Sunday’s MV/Berlin votes.

stories.title: Russian Generalkonsulat Bonn closed today after Leipzig drone incident

facts.text: As of Fri 18 Sep: Russian Generalkonsulat in Bonn is closed — flag lowered Tue, staff flown to Moscow Wed on a Russian state aircraft (German exception permit) (tagesschau).
Ordered ~2.5 weeks ago by FM Johann Wadephul as part of the response to the Leipzig/Halle explosives-drone case; Wadephul: “harte Reaktion” that curtails Russian options in Germany (tagesschau).

Russia called it a “grundlose Provokation” and ordered reciprocal closures of German facilities; Berlin says that was expected. Russisches Haus in Berlin also to close under the package (tagesschau / WDR).
Govt also signaled tougher action vs Russia’s Baltic “shadow fleet” oil tankers; Wadephul still says Germany wants a constructive relationship and remains open to dialogue (tagesschau).

stories.whyItMatters: The Leipzig response moves from announcement to facts on the ground — a concrete cut to Russia’s diplomatic footprint in Germany the morning after another Ukraine strike night.

stories.title: Pistorius takes delivery of Germany’s first F-35 in Fort Worth

facts.text: Fri: Defence Minister Boris Pistorius receives the first Lockheed Martin F-35A for the Luftwaffe in Fort Worth, Texas — end of his multi-day US trip (DLF; dpa-AFX).
Germany ordered 35 jets (2022) for ~€10bn to replace Tornados, including NATO nuclear-sharing roles; Pistorius called it “das modernste Kampfflugzeug der Welt” (t-online/dpa).
First eight stay in the US for German pilot/tech training; stationing at Büchel (Eifel) planned from 2027 (DLF).

stories.whyItMatters: Hardware milestone for Luftwaffe modernization and NATO nuclear sharing — timed as Berlin hardens its Russia posture.

stories.title: CDU floats 21–25¢/L fuel relief; MV CDU at 6% two days before votes

facts.text: CDU GS Franziska Hoppermann (ZDF Maybrit Illner, Thu night): concrete relief band “irgendwo 21, 23, 25 Cent” per litre; govt to tackle it early October with the Länder (FAZ).
She rejected Klingbeil’s windfall tax on oil firms as “kein Cent Entlastung” at the pump and again ruled out replacing Merz as chancellor (FAZ).
ZDF Politbarometer Extra (14–17 Sep): Mecklenburg-Vorpommern — SPD 37% / AfD 36% / CDU 6% (near 5% threshold); Berlin — Linke 22% / CDU 20% / AfD 18% ahead of Sunday’s votes (dpa/Volksstimme).
Fri: closing rallies in both states; no two-party majority likely in Berlin on current polls (dpa).

stories.whyItMatters: Fuel sticker-shock meets an existential state-election weekend for Merz’s CDU — concrete cents land before voters do.

stories.title: Ukraine Thursday barrage: 1 dead west of Kyiv; more Kyiv injuries

facts.text: Straits Times (Reuters, Thu late): industrial-park strike near Korosten (Zhytomyr) killed one; Zaporizhzhia market blaze (no casualties reported there); Dnipro fire injured two.
DW / Kyiv authorities: Russian strikes injured several in Kyiv and Odesa in the Thu wave — overnight Kyiv wounded reported in the teens–20s range depending on cut-off (DW).
Moscow mayor: 29 Ukrainian drones downed heading for Moscow through the day (via Reuters wire). Evening’s past-day ≥10/75 toll is the broader window; this is Thu’s continuation.

stories.whyItMatters: Another daylight-extended strike day as Bonn’s consulate closure lands — the hybrid/kinetic pressure track stays hot.

stories.title: Asia opens higher; oil eases as markets await BoJ

facts.text: ~02:00 GMT Fri: Nikkei 225 +0.7% (~64,555 on break), Hang Seng +0.9% (~24,834), Shanghai Composite +0.8% (~3,908) — tracking Wall St’s Thu bounce (HK Telegraph/AFP figures).
WTI ~$101.23 (−0.7%), Brent ~$104.03 (−0.8%); Saudi restoring ~half of East-West pipeline crude disrupted after Houthi hit cited as relief (HK Telegraph).
Yen softer ahead of expected BoJ +25 bp; focus on Ueda guidance after the decision (Pepperstone via HK Telegraph). Not a rehash of Thu’s US close — Friday Asia open.

stories.whyItMatters: Risk appetite into Friday Asia after the Fed week — oil still elevated vs pre-crisis, but off recent highs.
